info.name: Task List Backend API
info.description: Frontend-ready Postman collection for the Task List backend. Run the first folder in order: it logs in as the seeded demo user, captures authToken, then creates demo tasks, notes, a holiday, and a day-plan snapshot. Protected requests use Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}.

item.name: 00 Run This Demo Flow In Order
item.description: Use Postman's folder runner on this folder. It creates real demo data in the local database and captures IDs into variables for later requests.

request.description: Run this first. It checks /livez and sets runId, date, holidayDate, fromDate, and toDate. The demo date is intentionally random in the future so the day-plan unique constraint does not block repeated demos.

item.name: 02 Optional AI And File Uploads
item.description: These require Vertex credentials and/or manually selected files. They are intentionally separate from the basic demo flow.

request.description: Free-form text to AI task extraction. Requires working Vertex configuration. AI-created tasks are created for the backend's current date.
Multipart audio to AI task extraction. In Postman, manually select fusion-audio.wav or another audio file for the audio field.
Multipart image to AI OCR/task extraction. In Postman, manually select fusion-image.png or another image file for the image field.

item.name: Process Unified Text Audio Image With AI

request.description: Single fusion endpoint. At least one of text, audio, or image is required. Manually attach files if using audio/image.

formdata.value: Add one high priority follow-up task from this note.

request.description: Sprint 17: phase 1 of two-phase day closure. Runs AI feedback once, persists a draft row, and returns it. Re-calling on an existing draft returns the same payload without invoking Vertex. Requires a day plan for {{date}}.
Sprint 17: phase 2 of two-phase day closure. Finalizes a draft created by /review. No multipart, no audio. `commentary` is plain text (transcribe excuse voice clips via POST /transcribe first).
Sprint 17: reusable verbatim audio → text. Single-file multipart on field `audio` (10 MB max). No DB write, no task dispatch. Output is Roman-script Hinglish/English even for Hindi audio.
Fetches the submitted day closure for {{date}}.
